hook.en: From lions on the African savanna to polar bears on the Arctic ice, every animal is adapted to the vegetation and climate of its home.
hook.bm: Daripada singa di savana Afrika hingga beruang kutub di ais Artik, setiap haiwan menyesuaikan diri dengan tumbuhan dan iklim habitatnya.

bigIdeas.en: The world's main vegetation regions include tropical rainforest, savanna, desert, Mediterranean, temperate forest, coniferous forest (taiga) and tundra.
bigIdeas.bm: Kawasan tumbuhan utama dunia termasuk hutan hujan tropika, savana, gurun, Mediterranean, hutan sederhana, hutan konifer (taiga) dan tundra.

bigIdeas.en: Each region has wildlife adapted to it.
bigIdeas.bm: Setiap kawasan mempunyai hidupan liar yang menyesuaikan diri dengannya.

bigIdeas.en: Vegetation and wildlife give oxygen, regulate climate, provide resources and medicine, and support tourism.
bigIdeas.bm: Tumbuhan dan hidupan liar membekalkan oksigen, mengawal iklim, menyediakan sumber dan ubat, serta menyokong pelancongan.

label.bm: Hutan hujan tropika (Amazon, Congo, Asia Tenggara)

cells.en: Tall grass with scattered trees (acacia, baobab)
cells.bm: Rumput tinggi dengan pokok jarang (akasia, baobab)

definition.en: A large region with similar climate, vegetation and wildlife.
definition.bm: Kawasan luas dengan iklim, tumbuhan dan hidupan liar yang serupa.

definition.en: Tropical grassland with scattered trees and a dry season.
definition.bm: Padang rumput tropika dengan pokok jarang dan musim kemarau.

definition.en: Coniferous forest of cold northern regions.
definition.bm: Hutan konifer di kawasan utara yang sejuk.

definition.en: Treeless cold region with moss and lichen.
definition.bm: Kawasan sejuk tanpa pokok dengan lumut dan liken.

definition.en: A feature that helps a living thing survive in its environment.
definition.bm: Ciri yang membantu hidupan terus hidup dalam persekitarannya.

question.en: Explain one adaptation of the camel to the desert.
question.bm: Terangkan satu penyesuaian unta terhadap gurun.

steps.en: The desert is hot and dry with little food and water.
steps.bm: Gurun panas dan kering dengan sedikit makanan dan air.

steps.en: A camel stores fat in its hump and can go a long time without drinking.
steps.bm: Unta menyimpan lemak dalam bonggolnya dan boleh lama tanpa minum.

answer.en: Fat stored in the hump; wide feet for sand; long eyelashes against sand.
answer.bm: Lemak disimpan dalam bonggol; tapak kaki lebar untuk pasir; bulu mata panjang menghalang pasir.

prompt.en: Where is the world's largest tropical rainforest?
prompt.bm: Di manakah hutan hujan tropika terbesar di dunia?

explanation.en: The Congo Basin and Southeast Asia also have large rainforests.
explanation.bm: Lembangan Congo dan Asia Tenggara juga mempunyai hutan hujan yang luas.

prompt.en: Tall grasses with scattered acacia trees describe the…
prompt.bm: Rumput tinggi dengan pokok akasia yang jarang menggambarkan…

explanation.en: Found widely in Africa.

prompt.en: Which animal lives on the African savanna?
prompt.bm: Haiwan manakah hidup di savana Afrika?

explanation.en: Lions and giraffes also live there.
explanation.bm: Singa dan zirafah juga hidup di situ.

prompt.en: Coniferous forest (taiga) has trees such as…
prompt.bm: Hutan konifer (taiga) mempunyai pokok seperti…

explanation.en: Needle-shaped leaves reduce water loss.
explanation.bm: Daun berbentuk jarum mengurangkan kehilangan air.

prompt.en: The cold, treeless region with moss and lichen is called the ______.
prompt.bm: Kawasan sejuk tanpa pokok yang ditumbuhi lumut dan liken dipanggil ______.

explanation.en: Reindeer live there.

prompt.en: Cacti grow mainly in…
prompt.bm: Kaktus tumbuh terutamanya di…

explanation.en: They store water in their stems.

prompt.en: One global importance of rainforests is…
prompt.bm: Salah satu kepentingan global hutan hujan ialah…

explanation.en: They help regulate the world's climate.

options.en: producing oxygen and absorbing carbon dioxide
options.bm: menghasilkan oksigen dan menyerap karbon dioksida

prompt.en: Many medicines were first discovered from…
prompt.bm: Banyak ubat mula ditemui daripada…

explanation.en: Forests are natural laboratories.

prompt.en: Match each biome with its animal.
prompt.bm: Padankan biom dengan haiwannya.

explanation.en: Animals are adapted to their biome.

prompt.en: Why do conifers have needle-shaped leaves?
prompt.bm: Mengapakah pokok konifer berdaun seperti jarum?

explanation.en: Their cone shape also sheds snow.

options.en: To reduce water loss and let snow slide off
options.bm: Untuk mengurangkan kehilangan air dan membolehkan salji jatuh

prompt.en: The Mediterranean region has hot, dry summers and mild, wet winters. Which plant suits it?
prompt.bm: Kawasan Mediterranean mempunyai musim panas yang kering dan musim sejuk yang lembap. Tumbuhan manakah sesuai?

explanation.en: Thick waxy leaves reduce water loss.
explanation.bm: Daun tebal berlilin mengurangkan kehilangan air.

prompt.en: Arrange these biomes from the EQUATOR towards the NORTH POLE.
prompt.bm: Susun biom ini dari KHATULISTIWA ke arah KUTUB UTARA.

explanation.en: Temperature generally falls away from the equator.

prompt.en: Select ALL global importance of vegetation and wildlife.
prompt.bm: Pilih SEMUA kepentingan global tumbuhan dan hidupan liar.

explanation.en: Biodiversity is a global heritage.

prompt.en: How is the polar bear adapted to the Arctic?
prompt.bm: Bagaimanakah beruang kutub menyesuaikan diri dengan Artik?

explanation.en: White fur also gives camouflage.

options.en: Thick fur and a layer of fat keep it warm
options.bm: Bulu tebal dan lapisan lemak memanaskan badannya

options.en: It stores water in a hump

prompt.en: Large protected areas such as the Serengeti in Africa attract visitors, supporting ______.
prompt.bm: Kawasan dilindungi yang luas seperti Serengeti di Afrika menarik pelawat dan menyokong ______.

explanation.en: Tourism income funds conservation.

prompt.en: Why are rainforests called the "lungs of the Earth"?
prompt.bm: Mengapakah hutan hujan digelar "paru-paru dunia"?

explanation.en: They also store huge amounts of carbon.
explanation.bm: Ia juga menyimpan karbon dalam jumlah besar.

options.en: They produce large amounts of oxygen through photosynthesis
options.bm: Ia menghasilkan banyak oksigen melalui fotosintesis

prompt.en: Why does the tundra have no tall trees?
prompt.bm: Mengapakah tundra tiada pokok tinggi?

explanation.en: Roots cannot grow deep in frozen soil.
explanation.bm: Akar tidak boleh tumbuh dalam tanah beku.

options.en: Very low temperatures, a short growing season and frozen ground (permafrost)
options.bm: Suhu sangat rendah, musim pertumbuhan pendek dan tanah beku (permafrost)

prompt.en: How could destroying the Amazon rainforest affect Malaysia?
prompt.bm: Bagaimanakah kemusnahan hutan hujan Amazon boleh menjejaskan Malaysia?

explanation.en: Environmental problems cross borders.

options.en: It adds carbon dioxide to the atmosphere, worsening global warming that affects all countries
options.bm: Ia menambah karbon dioksida di atmosfera, memburukkan pemanasan global yang menjejaskan semua negara

options.en: It has no effect on Malaysia

prompt.en: Compare the vegetation of the savanna and the tropical rainforest.
prompt.bm: Bandingkan tumbuhan savana dengan hutan hujan tropika.

explanation.en: Rainfall pattern explains the difference.

options.en: Rainforest is dense and layered all year; savanna is grass with scattered trees due to a dry season
options.bm: Hutan hujan tebal dan berlapis sepanjang tahun; savana ialah rumput dengan pokok jarang akibat musim kemarau

prompt.en: Why should countries cooperate to protect wildlife that migrates?
prompt.bm: Mengapakah negara perlu bekerjasama melindungi hidupan liar yang berhijrah?

explanation.en: e.g. sea turtles and migratory birds.
explanation.bm: cth. penyu dan burung yang berhijrah.

options.en: Migrating animals cross borders, so protection in one country alone is not enough
options.bm: Haiwan berhijrah merentasi sempadan, jadi perlindungan di satu negara sahaja tidak mencukupi
Hanya satu negara memiliki hidupan liar
